html: I just got back from Bora Bora where I finished my author edit of Wormhole. It’s now in the hands of my literary agency, Janklow & Nesbit, who are in negotiations with a number of publishers for the Rho Agenda trilogy. As soon as I have an actual publication date, I’ll post it. In the meantime, I’ve begun work on my next novel, currently titled “The Ripper”, which is set before the Rho Agenda and follows my Jack Gregory character through his early days with the CIA and shows how he came to be known as The Ripper.

Loose ends, like worried and distraught parents, tug at me a bit, but maybe “Wormhole” ties it up nicely. Looking forward to the ebook. Thank you for your stories Mr. Phillips. – Rick

replies.author: Richard Phillips

The publisher sent over a contract, my agencies attorneys reviewed it and made a few changes, now the publisher’s attorneys are reviewing those changes. As soon as all that gets settled, then the series will be re-released (both in print and in all the eBook formats) under a new label. The publisher will have one of their editors review each of the novels, then I’ll review their changes, then it’ll go to publication. comments.author: Ed
comments.html:
Mr. Phillips,

Thanks again for letting me read your latest book Wormhole. What an ending to your trilogy! As a very big SF fan — awesome!

I promised to provide some comments — I only have a few minor corrections to keep references current. You reference NIMA. NIMA became the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in 2003. Additional, when you reference Global Hawk – the Ground Control Station is technically the Global Hawk Ground Segment which consists of the Launch and Recovery Element (LRE) and the Mission Control Element (MCE), Imagery supporting a mission is passed to the MCE and then usually forwarded to a Processing, Exploitation and Dissemenation (PED) for analysis and reporting.

Thanks again — worth the wait!

Ed
